main_text.head: N OBITVM NOBILISSIMI Herois Francisci Linouæi.
Ioan. Iacomoti Carmen.

p.i: SI, Musa, longos Threicio licet Sonare plectus pectine, si lyra Mœrente concedis decoras Nobilium lachrymare mortes: Nunc linque Pindi culmina: nunc leues Omitte risus, & Charitum iocos. Lugubre carmen, næniasque Funereas, memoresque tristis Effunde fletus. Occidit, occidit, Heul gentis ingens Francigenæ decus Noxius Heros. Hunc cruenti Vis rapuit truculenta Martis. Hunc luctuoso perdidit impotens Bellona tandem funere, patriam Seruare dum tendit ruentem: Dum Validis metuendus hostes Propulsat armis: & Lotharingicos Fastus retundit fortis, & impias Rebellione, & sceleftis Fœderibus sociata tela: Aut semimaurae signa Tyrannidis Infesta frangens, non finit impiger Ignota crudeles Iberos

page.notes: Several words are set in a mixed, partly italic and long-s-like face; "Heul gentis" likely "Heroum gentis" and "Rebellione," / "sceleftis" (scelestis) uncertain; "Threicio" and "Infesta" read with some doubt. Verse lines are set as printed; the first paragraph is one stanza-block.
